description: This file declares cryptographic signing functions within the 'cuttlefish::confui' namespace, including 'TestSign' for local test key signing and 'Sign' for secure environment signing, with associated includes and licensing information.

methods.name: TestSign
methods.description: Signs a message using a local test key, returning an optional vector of bytes containing the signature.

methods.name: Sign
methods.description: Signs a message using a secure environment, returning an optional vector of bytes containing the signature.
